description: This file manages web fetch provider plugins, including caching, plugin resolution, and registry handling within the OpenClaw project.

methods.name: resetWebFetchProviderSnapshotCacheForTests
methods.description: Resets the in-memory cache used for web fetch provider snapshots, primarily for testing purposes.

methods.name: buildWebFetchSnapshotCacheKey
methods.description: Constructs a cache key string based on parameters like config, workspace directory, environment, and plugin IDs.

methods.name: pluginManifestDeclaresWebFetch
methods.description: Determines if a plugin manifest declares web fetch providers via its contracts or config UI hints.

methods.name: resolveWebFetchCandidatePluginIds
methods.description: Resolves plugin IDs that declare web fetch capabilities, filtered by optional plugin ID list.

methods.name: resolveWebFetchLoadOptions
methods.description: Builds options for loading web fetch plugins, including environment, config, and activation settings.

methods.name: mapRegistryWebFetchProviders
methods.description: Maps and sorts web fetch providers from a plugin registry, filtering by plugin IDs if provided.
